title: Mom-Baby Archive v1 JSON Contracts
description: Machine-readable contracts for the v1 public core, encrypted manifest, record JSONL object, media chunk header and completion object. Cross-record ordering, hashes, references, SCCs, frame arithmetic and byte limits are additionally enforced by the companion registry and importer verifier.

core.$comment: Core bytes are RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 with no BOM. v1.0 feature_flags is exactly empty; a higher minor requires a new exact feature profile.

manifest.$comment: record_sets contains every registry kind exactly once in ordinal order. media_items is ordered by asset_id then variant. Frame indices are relative to the first non-manifest frame.

media_header.$comment: chunk_index is zero-based and strictly less than chunk_count. chunk_plaintext_length equals the raw chunk byte count and the frame plaintext length equals 2 + header_length + chunk_plaintext_length. One frame contains one chunk; chunks for an item are contiguous and non-interleaved.

completion.$comment: total_frame_count equals manifest_frame_count + record_frame_count + media_frame_count + 1. pre_completion_file_sha256 covers raw bytes [0, completion frame header offset).

payload_consent_record.$comment: scope_json is bounded historical opaque JSON text. It must be duplicate-key-free valid JSON, but never grants access after restore.

payload_timer_session.$comment: Archive materialization converts every non-terminal source session to abandoned, closes open segments at the persisted last_activity_at_ms, sets wall_only_after_process_loss and emits no final record. Therefore only finished or abandoned sessions are valid archive records. Cross-field time ordering is enforced by the domain verifier.

payload_timer_channel.$comment: Archive materialization emits only terminal ended/abandoned channels; active source channels are normalized to abandoned.

payload_timer_segment.$comment: Archive materialization closes every source segment; ended_at_ms is never null in v1 records.

payload_pumping_record.$comment: When either side amount is present, the domain verifier also requires total_ml == coalesce(left_ml,0) + coalesce(right_ml,0).

record.$comment: One complete RFC 8785 JCS object per JSONL line, followed by exactly LF (0x0A), no BOM, CRLF, empty line or cross-frame line. Maximum line length is 1 MiB.
